mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP by more than 1% in a quarter signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 drops by more than 1% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for 3 consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% in the same month, it signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS and INDPRO both increase by more than 1% in the same month.
